items.t: IonQ's QKD Systems Pass IDEMIA Validation for Critical Communications
items.sum: IONQ's QKD systems pass IDEMIA validation, strengthening its quantum-safe security strategy as cybersecurity customers and market opportunities expand.

items.t: IonQ Lost 25% of Its Value Over One Month: Near 200% Gains to Materialize According to This Wall Street Pro
items.sum: IonQ posted record revenue and a sold-out 2027 order book, yet its shares keep sinking. A $2 billion stock sale, a widening loss, and shrinking analyst targets raise one question: who is right about this quantum leader?

items.t: IonQ Has Delivered 6 Consecutive Record Quarters. The Bull Case Is Getting Stronger
items.sum: IonQ keeps posting record results and selling out its future capacity, yet the stock has been cut nearly in half this year. What would it take for shares to more than double again, and what could derail the climb?

items.t: IonQ Stock Has The Bull Case Changed After Raised Revenue Guidance

items.t: What Do IonQ (IONQ) Quantum Sensing Wins Mean For Its Broader Growth Story?
items.sum: IonQ (NYSE: IONQ) subsidiary Vector Atomic received a DARPA Phase II Option award to develop an airborne quantum gravimeter. Vector Atomic completed a 51 day maritime deployment of its Evergreen-30 optical atomic clock to test performance at sea.
